property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of pages in the section.

property.name: alternateLayoutLength
property.shortdesc: The number of pages in the alternate layout section.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the Section.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the Section (a Document).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the Section within its containing object.

property.name: pageNumberStyle
property.shortdesc: The page number style. Can return: PageNumberStyle enumerator or String.

property.name: continueNumbering
property.shortdesc: If true, continues page numbers sequentially from the previous section.

property.name: includeSectionPrefix
property.shortdesc: If true, places the specified prefix before page numbers on all pages in the section.

property.name: pageNumberStart
property.shortdesc: The page number assigned to the first page in the section. Note: Valid only when continue numbering is false.

property.name: pageStart
property.shortdesc: The start page for the section.

property.name: sectionPrefix
property.shortdesc: The prefix to place before page numbers on pages in the section. May include up to 8 characters. Note: Valid only when include section prefix is true.

property.name: alternateLayout
property.shortdesc: The alternate layout name for a set of pages.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Section.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
